Required. Without this, Android or your phone\'s battery manager can kill the gesture service in the background, so gestures can\'t run reliably.
Also open Settings › Battery › Background usage limits and make sure Ogesture is not in the \"Sleeping apps\" or \"Deep sleeping apps\" list.
Also enable the \"Autostart\" permission for Ogesture in your phone\'s settings (on Xiaomi: Security app › Permissions › Autostart). Without it, the gesture service can be killed in the background.

A few apps ignore gesture taps. See which, and turn Ogesture off for them if you want.

A few apps ignore simulated touches for security, or restrict overlay apps in other ways. Ogesture passes your edge taps through as simulated touches, so in those apps a tap near a screen edge may not register. Swipes for Back, Home, and Recents still work fine.\n\nIf dead taps bother you in an app below, turn Ogesture off for it — every tap will land normally again, and you\'ll use your phone\'s own navigation inside that app. Ogesture stays on for every app by default.
None of the commonly affected apps are installed on this phone.
Gestures also won\'t work on your phone\'s Settings app: Android hides overlay apps like Ogesture on Settings and other secure system screens. Use your phone\'s own navigation there.
Android\'s security policy blocks gestures on certain screens, such as your phone\'s Settings pages.
